verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm Morph publishes an llms.txt at docs.morphllm.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Its docs pages are also served as agent-readable Markdown (.md) that direct agents to the full documentation index in llms.txt. Many cited doc URLs are .md variants, so an agent can be pointed directly at them. missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
